plan.title: Vendor quote revision during live submission

steps.note: Create the pricing event needed for quote submission.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Keep the submission window running for the revision.
Invite one QA vendor to submit and revise its quote.
Publish the event so the vendor can quote.
Confirm the event is live and published.
Move to the invited vendor's supplier portal.
Open the live RFQ quote sheet.
Confirm the initial response was accepted.
Confirm the revised response was accepted and submitted again.
Return to the buyer console to inspect the submitted response.
Open the buyer's comparison grid for the live event.
Verify the changed quote value is held in the submitted response.
